explanation: L0/N1274+ is a layer-0 letter-c spelling detector - the c-counterpart of this layer's L-initial-token detector N1653 - whose input is only the current token's embedding, so its strength is a fixed function of the token id (identical in every context and at every position, all input attribution on the peak token, every high snippet peaking on the c-piece itself); it fires on BPE pieces that spell c at a piece edge, i.e. c-final fragments the tokenizer cut out of a word at c ('ec' 1.63, 'ac' 1.37, 'ic' 1.30, 'oc' 1.15, 'uc' 1.19, 'OC' 1.48, 'éc' 1.47, 'roc' 1.51, ' bic' 1.52, 'bc' 1.37, 'cc' 1.08, 'extrac', 'intrac', 'inoc', 'Proc', 'Rec', 'Dec') and c-initial pieces (' C' 0.92, ' Cl' 0.99, ' cl' 0.62, ' cu' 0.76, ' cat' 0.62, ' cough' 0.70), plus a scattered set of c-medial Latinate/technical words that cross the line as whole tokens (' process' 1.11, 'call' 1.51, ' call' 1.07, ' times' 1.12, ' twice' 0.78, ' term' 0.77, ' transfer' 0.65, ' contact' 0.65, ' exact' 0.60, ' products' 0.55, ' procedure' 0.69, ' academic' 0.70, ' cystic' 1.43, ' primary' 0.45, ' temporal' 0.44, ' systematic' 0.43, ' concept' 0.43, ' protocol' 0.42, ' static' 0.41, ' dental' 0.41); predict inactive for ordinary c-words (' magic' -0.04, 'logic' -0.14, 'economic' -0.10, 'specific' -0.12, 'public' 0.18, 'music' -0.02, 'class' -0.15, 'city' -0.16, 'can' 0.02, 'come' -0.17, 'cake' 0.10, ' cup' 0.15, 'contract' 0.16, 'plastic' -0.10, and the technical-but-quiet ' method' 0.16, 'function' 0.11, 'system' -0.07, 'test' 0.10, 'value' -0.16, 'code' 0.04), for whole c-final tokens the tokenizer never splits (Spanish 'capacidad' splits into ' capac' 0.23 + 'idad', ' panic' 0.26) and for the -*atic/-*etic/-*istic/-*ic suffix pieces that sit just under the active line ('estic' 0.38 in majestic/Domestic, 'atic' 0.20, 'etic' 0.37, 'istic' 0.03, 'crib' 0.38 in describe, 'lic' 0.28, 'mic' 0.30), though a few of that family do cross ('emic' 0.78, 'onic' 0.41, 'nic' 0.49); because the trigger is the piece, not the word, the same spelling flips with its split - ' domestic' is one token at 0.64 but capitalized 'Domestic' becomes 'Dom'+'estic' (0.38), ' cup' is 0.15 but bare 'cup' 0.46, and bare 'OCaml' gives 'OC'+'aml' (1.48) while ' OCaml' after a space gives ' O'+'Cam'+'l' (0.40) - so near-miss pieces are token-specific, not compositional ('-etic' 0.37 beside '-emic' 0.78).
